record.question: According to 2011 census the most literate district in India was
record.explanation: Answer C: Serchhip, Mizoram. Serchhip is the most literate district in the 2011 census comparison. The provisional all-India census ranking places it first at 98.76%; final Mizoram census figures revise Serchhip to 97.91% and Aizawl to 97.89%, preserving Serchhip's lead. Do not confuse the two statistical vintages or repeat a district website's contrary second-highest wording. Historical/source note: Census 2011; provisional and final percentages differ. Answer identity remains Serchhip. Reference: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/42611/download/46274/Census%20of%20India%202011-Provisional%20Population%20Totals.pdf; https://des.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/bc8b20d8b7faf9239cc04646708b1d87/pages-78-handbook-2016.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
